remove_duplicates: remove duplicated tasks from a project queryset, moving annotations to the first task
find_duplicated_tasks_by_data: find duplicated tasks by data fields and return them grouped as a dictionary
move_annotations: move annotations from duplicated tasks to the first task in each duplicate group
restore_storage_links_for_duplicated_tas: restore storage links from a duplicated task to other tasks sharing the same data
remove_duplicated_tasks: remove duplicate tasks from a queryset while preserving annotated tasks
